name: densepack-marketplace
description: The DensePack marketplace. One plugin: DensePack, which cuts the input tokens a lead agent pays to read its subagents' reports.

plugins.name: densepack
plugins.description: Free, local, private, automatic, dense. Subagent reports arrive as dense packed images the lead reads at roughly half the input tokens, every report prints a measured savings receipt, and the skill adds a cheap-first delegation method. Nothing leaves your machine.
